question: In the 63-publication biofeedback review, how many reports used live HRV, heartbeat, EEG, a derived indicator and a documented proprietary score? Can reports overlap? Who was masked in the inpatient trial (DOI 10.3390/brainsci16070748)? Please cite the review and trial in under 120 words.
renderedAnswer:
The 63-publication *Mindfulness Biofeedback / AR / VR / Mixed Reality* review reports:
- Live HRV: 7 reports
- Heart rate/heartbeat: 10
- EEG: 7
- Derived indicators: 9
- Explicitly documented proprietary scores: 2, both HeartMath coherence scores included within the nine derived indicators. [1]

Reports can overlap across categories; these counts are not additive. “Live” means the input changed what participants saw, heard or felt—not merely an outcome measurement. [1]

In the 188-person inpatient trial (DOI 10.3390/brainsci16070748), the psychiatrist assessing anxiety was masked to treatment allocation. This documents assessor masking, not double masking of participants and intervention providers. [2]

citationCards.title: Mindfulness Biofeedback / AR / VR / Mixed Reality
